Resolve the smoke+area Playwright test selection a local `make check` runs, from the current git diff against the merge base (see erun-ui/playwright/AGENTS.md). Always exits 0 and prints "all" when the selection cannot be resolved (no git repository, or no merge base against any candidate upstream branch) -- the fail-safe direction, matching the Dockerfile's own unset-PLAYWRIGHT_TEST_AREAS default of running everything.

Usage:
  erun exec resolve-playwright-areas [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for resolve-playwright-areas

Global Flags:
      --output string   Result format: text (default, human stream) or json (structured result on stdout for orchestrators). (default "text")
      --time            Print the elapsed runtime after the command finishes.
  -v, --verbose count   Increase verbosity: -v streams external tool output, -vv adds erun command traces.
